VIDEO SCRIPT: BELIEF IN REVEALED SCRIPTURES
Grade: Grade 8 · Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION

[0:00–0:20] HOOK
• Host: “Today we learn Belief in revealed scriptures. Watch the example, then you try.”

[0:20–2:00] TEACH
• identify the revealed scriptures to strengthen their Iman
• explain the reasons for the revelation of the revealed scriptures as a guide for mankind
• identify the similarities in the revealed scriptures for religious tolerance
• describe ways of showing respect for the revealed scriptures to promote religious tolerance

[2:00–4:00] WORKED EXAMPLE ON SCREEN
• Model 1: identify the revealed scriptures to strengthen their Iman

• Model 3: identify the similarities in the revealed scriptures for religious tolerance

[4:00–5:00] TRY THIS (PAUSE)
• Practise: identify the revealed scriptures to strengthen their Iman
• Practise: explain the reasons for the revelation of the revealed scriptures as a guide for mankind
• Practise: identify the similarities in the revealed scriptures for religious tolerance

[5:00–5:30] REMEMBER + CTA
• Recap 3 bullets. “Now open Revision Quiz for Belief in revealed scriptures.”
